content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the WCD Odisha Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 14/10/2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of WCD Odisha to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Women and Child Development Department Odisha (WCD Odisha) for CDPO Bhabanipatna Urban.

faq.question: Q2. What are the total vacancies available under WCD Odisha Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available for Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Sahayika posts in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 14/10/2026. Candidates must complete their application before this deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification for Anganwadi Worker?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Anganwadi Worker post must have passed +2 / Higher Secondary (12th) or an equivalent examination.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification needed for Anganwadi Sahayika?
faq.answer: Applicants for the Anganwadi Sahayika position must have passed their 10th standard examination from a recognized board.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for WCD Odisha Recruitment?
faq.answer: The candidate's age should be between 18 years and 35 years as per the guidelines specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by visiting the official portal at http://engagement-awc.odisha.gov.in and completing the registration and form submission steps.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for WCD Odisha jobs?
faq.answer: The selection process involves preparing a merit list based on the marks secured in the qualifying examination, followed by the verification of original certificates.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for submitting the online application form.

faq.question: Q10. What is the monthly salary for an Anganwadi Sahayika?
faq.answer: The Anganwadi Sahayika will receive a monthly honorarium/salary of Rs. 8000/- per month as per the government rules.
